title: The Great Buddha Art
summary: At Mu Realm, Zhou Ye wants to hit back at Liu Realm for its border raids, but Mu Feng holds him off: Liu Realm is still stronger, and its lord Liu Qingtian is at Spirit like Mu Feng. Mu Chen comes home at the initial phase of Spiritual Movement and says he has agreed to fight Liu Yang, second young lord of Liu Realm, in the upcoming exam. In the Spiritual Art Room he passes over the Flame Dragon Art and picks the unranked Great Buddha Art, which Mu Feng reveals his mother Jing left for him. He trains it, and Mu Feng has his Spirit-level Dragon Flame Eagle, held down to initial-phase Spiritual Movement, test him for three moves. Liu Mubai gives Liu Yang a Spirit Destruction Bead as a last resort. At the North Spiritual Academy exam Mu Chen is late, so Tan Qingshan, newly at Spiritual Movement, takes on Liu Yang himself and is beaten badly, until Mu Chen arrives and steps in.

title: Mu Chen defeats Liu Yang
summary: Hong Ling looks after the beaten Tan Qingshan while Liu Yang taunts Mu Chen, sure that his middle-phase Spiritual Movement beats Mu Chen's initial phase. Liu Mubai and Hong Ling watch from the stands. Mu Chen reads Liu Yang's attacks, and when Liu Yang uses the Liu family's Flame Palm he turns to the Great Buddha Art and breaks through to the middle phase of Spiritual Movement mid-fight, then wins. Liu Yang tries to use the Spirit Destruction Bead; Mu Chen snatches it, Liu Mubai asks for it back, and Master Mo exposes it. Master Mo and Master Xi debate stripping Liu Yang of his promotion, but Mu Chen keeps the bead as Liu Yang's apology and lets the matter drop. Mu Chen, Tan Qingshan, Liu Yang and the other Spiritual Movement students of the Earth class are promoted to the Heaven class. Liu Ming reports that Blood Slaughter is hiding in the North Spiritual Plain.

title: The Senluo Death Mark
summary: Mu Chen persuades Tang Qian'er to borrow the dangerous Senluo Death Mark from the second floor of the Spiritual Art Room, which only Heaven class seniors may read; she agrees on the condition that he only practices it with her and teams up with her for the North Spiritual Plain training in six months, where the top three teams win Spirit Fostering Medicine. Hong Ling offers help and is turned away by a jealous Qian'er. They go to the core of the academy's Level 3 Spirit Collecting Formation, where Mo Ling points out Luo Tong, an 18-year-old of Luo Realm who never reached Spiritual Rotation and picks fights. The Death Mark runs out of control and drains the formation, until the Great Buddha Art suppresses the backfire and Mu Chen gains initial success. Luo Tong, at late-phase Spiritual Movement, demands a fight over the core-area rule and uses the Daluo Sword Art, and Mu Chen beats him with the Senluo Death Mark. Mo Ling introduces himself and asks Mu Chen to team up, but he is already with Qian'er.

title: Blood Slaughter and the Silver-Horned Panther Dragon
summary: In the North Spiritual Plain, the adult Silver-Horned Panther Dragon, an advanced Spirit-level beast, turns up as Mu Chen fights for Jade Spirit fruits. Blood Slaughter, the fugitive who wounded the young panther dragon, demands the fruits; Mu Chen tricks him and leads him to the enraged adult, which kills him. From the body Mu Chen takes a Mustard Bracelet holding a copper piece whose totem, a beast he cannot name, frightens him. Liu Mubai and his uncle Liu Ming, third leader of Liu Realm, track Blood Slaughter and find the Senluo Death Mark on the corpse. Mu Chen reaches Tang Qian'er's group as they are overwhelmed by beasts and saves them with the spirit of the King of Ice Spirit Apes. Liu Ming tries to search him, but Master Mo, a Spirit-level instructor, drives the Liu party off. Mu Chen shares out the Jade Spirit fruits with the friends he met, including a girl from Jiulong Fortress.

title: Liu Zong, Wen Ling and the Dark Abyss
summary: Liu Zong, second head of Liu Realm and a Spirit-level fighter, corners Mu Chen for the copper piece until Zhou Ye arrives, alerted by a letter Mu Chen sent through Tan Qingshan. At home Mu Chen, at the middle phase of Spiritual Movement, shows Mu Feng the piece; Mu Feng recognises the Jiuyou Bird, 11th on the earth list of beasts, and the piece reveals that it failed an evolution and fell somewhere. Liu Qingtian orders his men into the Dark Abyss to take the bird. Mu Feng agrees to take Mu Chen only if he reaches late-phase Spiritual Movement before they leave, and tells him the Great Buddha Art resonates with his mother's bloodline. At Mu Realm's Spirit Collecting Formation Square, the Level 1 spiritual formation master Wen Ling watches Mu Chen form five spiritual seals on his first try and gives him two formation maps. Mu Chen reaches late-phase Spiritual Movement, and the Mu party enters the Dark Abyss, where Liu Qingtian is waiting.

title: The first rounds for the academy places
summary: The competition for the Five Great Academies' places begins in front of Mr. Hao, who has come to see what Mu Chen can do. In the first round Mu Chen faces Chen Tong, second only to Liu Mubai in the West Academy, who keeps aiming Flame Heart-Breaking Palm at his face; Mu Chen outpaces him, slaps him, and forces him to concede after his Flame Storm Spiritual Fist. Tang Qian'er and Hong Ling fight to a standstill before Mr. Hao stops the bout without naming a winner, which tells Mu Chen that performance matters more than the result. He tells Mo Ling this before Mo Ling's hopeless fight with Liu Mubai. Mo Ling refuses to give up while Liu Mubai toys with him, until Mr. Hao ends it. Liu Mubai and then Mu Chen volunteer for the single seeded place.

title: The seeded place and Northern Heaven
summary: Liu Qingtian interrupts the seeded-place duel, accusing Mu Chen of trying to kill Liu Mubai and pushing for a draw, but Mr. Hao rules that Liu Mubai, knocked off the stage by his own father's intervention, has lost, and Mu Chen takes the seeded place. Mr. Hao names the others who earned places, including Hong Ling, Tang Qian'er, Liu Mubai and, as an exception for his courage, Mo Ling; Qian'er and Hong Ling go to the all-female Phoenix Spiritual Academy. Mu Chen asks about Ji Xuan and Luo Li, both rated King level on the Spiritual Land; hearing Luo Li chose the Northern Heaven Spiritual Academy, he remembers their promise and chooses it too. Liu Qingtian decides to destroy Mu Realm within the two months before the students leave. In Mu Chen's Sea of Chi, Jiu You, trapped by the black paper he found on the Spiritual Land, sneers that he is only at Spiritual Rotation but softens when he says he won't take her spirit. Wen Ling reports the Level 2 Spirit Collecting Formation working and gives Mu Chen, now at 18 spiritual seals, the 20-seal Nine Heavens Thunder Spiritual Formation, just as news comes that General Chen Xiong has been killed at the border.

title: The Meeting of the Nine Realms
summary: With the Mount Mangyin Sect's remnants wiped out alongside Jiulong Fortress (Nine Dragon City), Zhou Ye and Mu Chen are offered Yang Gui's secret treasure room; Mu Chen takes a Nine-Root Blood Ginseng and a fragmentary map of the Demon Lotus Spirit-Slaying Formation, a Level 3 formation needing 100 spiritual seals. Word arrives that Mu Feng has gone alone to Liu Realm for a Meeting of the Nine Realms, and Mu Chen realises the Mangyin attack was a decoy. Camping on the way, he refines the ginseng with the Great Buddha Art; the flower cage turns on the Jiuyou Bird mid-breakthrough, he calms it, and he reaches the late stage of Spiritual Rotation. At Liu Realm, Liu Qingtian proposes a Northern Spiritual Alliance under himself; Lie Yan, Lord of Lie Realm, walks out and is killed by Liu Jingshan, Liu Qingtian's supposedly dead father, who has broken through to Heavenly Fusion. Bai Realm submits, while Mu, Tang, Hong and Luo realms refuse.

title: Borrowing the Jiuyou Bird's Power
summary: In Liu Realm's square, Liu Jingshan crushes the combined lords Mu Feng, Tang Shan, Hong Ling (Senior) and the Luo Realm lord with the Wind and Fire Spiritual Wave. Watching from hiding, Zhou Ye wants to take Mu Chen away, but Mu Chen refuses to abandon his father. He bargains with the Jiuyou Bird: he will ease the flower cage's suppression and owe her a promise if she lends him her power. When Liu Jingshan moves to kill the lords and their children, Mu Chen intervenes with power at the Heavenly Fusion level borrowed from her, and trades blows with him (Mountain God Art and Mountain Moving Fist against the Spiritual Emperor's Finger). Liu Jingshan says the power is not Mu Chen's own and prepares the Land Subduing Mountain.

title: Demon Lotus against the Double-headed Demon Dog
summary: Powered by the Jiuyou Bird, Mu Chen forges a fourth Senluo Death Mark and breaks Liu Jingshan's Mountain God Art, but she warns the borrowed Heavenly Fusion power will tear his body apart if the fight drags on. Liu Jingshan summons the spirit of his Double-headed Demon Dog, 98th on the Earth list of beasts, and fuses with it at the cost of his own cultivation. Using the Heart Formation state to dodge while laying seals, Mu Chen completes the Level 3 Demon Lotus Spirit-Slaying Formation. It overcomes Liu Jingshan's Black Dragon Wind and Fire Execution, and when the old man tries to flee Mu Chen kills him. The lords marvel that Mu Realm has such a trump card, and Mu Chen collapses at his limit.

title: Farewell to the North Spiritual Territory
summary: Mu Chen wakes after days in a coma to hear from Tang Qian'er that killing Liu Jingshan ended the Meeting of the Nine Realms and made Mu Realm the strongest power in the territory. The Jiuyou Bird, weakened in spirit form, sets her price for the loan: essence and blood of the Dragon Fish of Beiming, a beast on the Heaven list that the Northern Heaven Spiritual Academy holds, and Mu Chen promises to get it. He tells Mu Feng how her spirit entered him in the Dark Abyss; Mu Feng gives him the Level 2 Golden Wheel Spirit Cracking Formation map and says he himself is on the threshold of Heavenly Fusion. After farewells to Mu Feng, Zhou Ye and Tang Shan, Mu Chen joins Dean Xiao and Mr. Hao at the North Spiritual Academy, parts with Tang Qian'er, who is bound for the Phoenix Spiritual Academy, and steps into the transmission formation for the Northern Heaven Spiritual Academy, thinking of Luo Li.

title: The Northern Heaven Domain Test
summary: The freshmen arrive on a Reception Platform in the Northern Heaven Domain, one of four test spaces; a monitor explains that each trainee's mark is rated on nine levels (regular places start at Level 1, seeded at 3, core at 5), that they must reach the Northern Heaven Palace at the centre with at least Level 4, and that marks can be raised by killing spiritual beasts or taken from others. Elsewhere, Luo Li starts as a core-place student at Level 5. Mu Chen and Mo Ling travel together; Mu Chen feeds a beast spirit to the Jiuyou Bird and rescues a young formation master, Ye Sun'er, from golden crocodiles. Ge Qing and two companions, all at late Spiritual Rotation, ambush him for his Level 3 mark; he beats all three with the Great Buddha Art and the Tiger Flame Spirit Consuming Formation cast in the Heart Formation state, and takes their marks. Ge Qing vows his eldest brother, now at Spirit, will make him pay.

title: Ge Hai and Ye Qingling
summary: Mu Chen and Mo Ling feed Ye Sun'er, a 14-year-old seeded formation master looking for her sister, who took the Spiritual Land trial. Ge Qing reports to his brother Ge Hai, leader of the Ge Gang, who carries a scar Mu Chen gave him in the Spiritual Land and wants revenge. Mu Chen masters the third Senluo Death Mark and coaches Sun'er through a fight with two Iron Rhinoceroses. The Ge Gang arrives; Ye Qingling, Sun'er's sister and leader of the Ye Gang, now at Spirit herself, steps in, but Mu Chen fights Ge Hai alone. Though Ge Hai is at Spirit and Mu Chen only at late Spiritual Rotation, Mu Chen wins with the Heart Formation and the Nine Heavens Thunder Spiritual Formation. To buy his freedom, Ge Hai tells him about a Divine Reishi in a valley guarded by three high-class spiritual beasts.

title: The Divine Reishi Valley
summary: Chu Qi, leader of the Chu Clan, kills a Thorned Beast and learns from the Ge Gang where Mu Chen is headed; having joined the academy for Luo Li, he resolves to show Mu Chen who suits her better. Ye Qingling agrees to team up if Mu Chen explains his tie to 'Lord Luo', Luo Li's title from her King-level evaluation, and tells him that at the Spiritual Land's last stop Luo Li attacked Ji Xuan and cost him the Spirit Crown, leaving his life for Mu Chen to take. In the Reishi Valley three high-class beasts at early Spirit guard the Divine Reishi. Ye Qingling's group distracts them while Mu Chen casts the Golden Wheel Spirit Cracking Formation; it kills one, and when the other two survive, Sun'er's pre-set Wind Dragon Breaking Sky Formation and Mu Chen's Nine Heavens Thunder Spiritual Formation finish them. The others insist Mu Chen take the Divine Reishi, and he sits down to break through to Spirit.

title: Spirit Stage, and Chu Qi's Challenge
summary: Mu Chen absorbs the Divine Reishi with the Great Buddha Art; when its energy overwhelms him the Jiuyou Bird takes some of it, and he breaks through to the Spirit stage, seeing his divine soul for the first time and discovering the Great Buddha Art's hidden Buddha Hand. Chu Qi, at middle Spirit, arrives and waits for him to finish, then demands he stay away from Luo Li, who saved Chu Qi in the Spiritual Land and told him she likes Mu Chen. Chu Qi breaks the Golden Wheel Spirit Cracking Formation, but Mu Chen's Great Buddha Art, Golden Crystal Fist and Buddha Hand beat him. Chu Qi offers a Level 7 mark, which Mu Chen declines, then gives him the Level 2 Dragon Elephant Formation and asks him to hunt a heaven-level beast. Meanwhile Luo Li, about to kill a One-Eyed Ape for a Level 9 mark, hears Mu Chen has gone to the Ice Valley and sets off after him.

title: Two Heaven-level Beasts in the Ice Valley
summary: Chu Qi describes the Ice Valley and its guardian, and Mu Chen identifies it from the sketch as the Frost Spirit Dragon, 73rd on the Earth list of beasts, whose full strength after three sheddings rivals late Heavenly Fusion; he reasons it is probably still at early Heavenly Fusion. The Jiuyou Bird urges him to take its essence now that he is at Spirit. Only Spirit-level fighters go in, leaving Ye Sun'er and Mo Ling behind. A crowd, including Xie Guan, is waiting; the dragon comes out, fights at early Heavenly Fusion strength and eliminates many attackers before being worn down. Then a second heaven-level beast, the Flame Spirit Lizard, 70th on the Earth list, bursts from underground, beats the tired dragon, and chases it as it flees. Mu Chen decides to take both beasts with the Jiuyou Bird's help, and the others race after him.

title: Blood Connection
summary: Luo Li arrives at the Ice Valley asking for Mu Chen. Mu Chen lowers the flower cage's hold so the Jiuyou Bird can fight, and between them they take the spirits of both the Frost Spirit Dragon and the Flame Spirit Lizard. With Jiuyou spent, he tricks the Spirit-level pursuers with an ordinary beast spirit and escapes under Qin Zheng's nose, while Luo Li shows a Level 8 mark and follows his trail. The Jiuyou Bird devours both spirits, but their cold and hot energy clash, and the black paper (the flower cage) moves to erase her. Mu Chen shields her inside its light net, and she tells him the only way out is a blood connection that binds their lives and power. He agrees without hesitation, and the connection succeeds.

title: Reunion with Luo Li
summary: Qin Zheng, Wu Hu and Xie Guan track Mu Chen down, but Luo Li arrives and strikes Wu Hu; the three know she was already at Heavenly Fusion when she finished the Spiritual Land. A flashback shows the Spiritual Land, where Luo Li promised to guard Mu Chen's back and he was expelled. Reunited, Luo Li leaves the trio to him; they sneer that absorbing the spirit only raised him to middle Spirit while they are at late Spirit, but he beats all three at once with the Dragon Elephant Formation cast in the Heart Formation state. He shares their seals with Ye Qingling's group, Luo Li gives Ye Qingling the spirit of the Unicorn, 87th on the Earth list, and Luo Li tells him Wen Qingxuan won the Spirit Crown while she wounded Ji Xuan, and that Ji Xuan's follower Yang Hong also chose the Northern Heaven Spiritual Academy. At the Northern Heaven Palace site, eighth-level seals do nothing, but Luo Li's ninth-level seal summons the palace.

title: Challenging Senior An Ran
summary: Inside the Northern Heaven Palace, senior student An Ran congratulates the freshmen and hands out spirit value cards; spirit value buys arts, formation maps and beast spirits in the academy and is earned through tasks, beast spirits and trades. Freshmen with Level 7 marks and above may challenge seniors by lot for 5,000 spirit value, and Bing Qing, Mu Kui and Yang Hong have already won in the other palaces. Mu Chen, at middle Spirit, draws An Ran herself, who is at Heavenly Fusion. She breaks his Buddha Hand and Dragon Elephant Formation and summons the Golden Eagle of Beiming, 65th on the Earth list, but he taps the blood connection with the Jiuyou Bird, using her burning fire and Ice Wings, and wins. Luo Li wins her bout easily; the freshmen then enter the Northern Heaven Spiritual Academy.

title: The Divine Soul Ranking
summary: An Ran shows the freshmen the Divine Soul Ranking, which pays daily spirit value to its top ten and is gamed by people on the verge of Heavenly Fusion, and the Heavenly Ranking for students of the three Heaven stages, headed by Shen Cangsheng, with Li Xuantong second, Wang Zhong eighth and Zhou Fan tenth. Mu Chen sees Bing Qing of the Ice Spirit Race, Mu Kui, and his Spiritual Land rival Yang Hong, who mocks him for being only at middle Spirit; they agree to settle it at the freshmen assembly. Mu Chen spends his spirit value on a First Class dormitory to share with Luo Li. To afford the 20,000 Divine Soul Pill that Luo Li says will take him to late Spirit, he enters the Divine Soul Ranking and takes third place from Mo Lun, earning enough to buy it. He sees that the Dragon Fish of Beiming essence and blood costs 7 million, and a clerk asks whether Luo Li is of the Luo God Race; she will not say. Mu Chen heads into the Thunder Realm to refine the pill.

title: The Thunder Realm and the Luo Club
summary: In the Thunder Realm, whose ten floors grow stronger toward a top floor meant for Heavenly Transformation, Mu Chen climbs to the third floor, refines the Divine Soul Pill with the thunder and reaches late Spirit. Sensing a breakthrough in the Great Buddha Art, he forces his way through the light curtain to the fourth floor, meant for Heavenly Fusion, draws the thunder onto himself, and brings the Great Buddha Art to its conversion level: 'Transform my body into a pagoda.' Meanwhile Mo Lun, the man he displaced on the Divine Soul Ranking, brings Qinghong Club members to the freshmen dormitory hurts several freshmen, and confronts Mo Ling and Ye Sun'er. Warned by An Ran, Mu Chen returns, defeats Mo Lun's Golden Flame Finger and Golden Flame Horn, and fines him 200,000 spirit value, which he shares among the freshmen. Hearing that Yang Hong and Mu Kui have formed the Flying Dragon Club and the Iron Wood Gang, the freshmen found the Luo Club with Mu Chen and Luo Li in charge.

title: The Spirit Flag on North Spiritual Mountain
summary: The freshmen competition is under way on North Spiritual Mountain, where the first freshman to reach the portal and take the Spirit Flag at the summit wins; Li Xuantong, second on the Heavenly Ranking, watches as if someone among the freshmen has caught his eye. Yang Hong's attack on Mu Chen and Luo Li turns out to be aimed at a baby Mountain Devouring Python, 86th on the Earth list, which Mu Chen fights off with the Buddha Hand while a swarm of Hell Beasts closes in. Mu Chen, Luo Li, Yang Hong and Mu Kui reach the portal into a magma cavern where a huge imprisoned beast attacks with magma hands, and Mu Chen works out that stone pillars mark the limit of its reach. He forces a way through, with Yang Hong and Mu Kui close behind, and the group reaches the Spirit Flag. Mu Chen and Yang Hong finally square off, while another contender says they will challenge the winner.

title: Mu Chen vs Yang Hong
summary: The freshman assembly reaches its decisive fight: Yang Hong reveals he is already at the middle phase of Heavenly Fusion and vows to crush Mu Chen for the Spiritual Land. Mu Chen, still only at the late phase of Spirit, answers with spiritual formations: the Golden Wheel Spirit Cracking Formation, the Dragon Elephant Formation and, using a Level 2 formation as bait, the Level 3 Grand Flame Demon Formation, which shows he has also mastered the primary Heart Formation. Yang Hong summons the spirit of the Ancient Tiger Dragon, 50th on the Earth list of beasts, and Mu Chen replies with the Jiuyou Bird's spirit, stunning the watching seniors. Mu Chen then refuses to lean on Jiuyou and finishes the fight with the Great Buddha Art's black pagoda, leaving Yang Hong unconscious. Exhausted, Mu Chen hands the Spirit Flag to Luo Li; Mu Kui and another finalist give up too, so Luo Li is declared first among the freshmen without making a move. The next day Elder Zhu Tian leads the freshmen to the Spiritual Arts Divine Hall.

title: The black paper's choice
summary: Elder Zhu Tian explains the Spiritual Arts Divine Hall: spiritual arts float in the light channel, and grabbing a powerful one teleports the student to a challenge hall where a guard matched to the art must be beaten. Separated from the others, Mu Chen passes over the Thunder Fist and grabs the Quasi-Divine Nine Dragons Heavenly Wind Art, but the mysterious black paper in his body pulls him into the innermost depths of the channel. There it hands him the Constellation Sutra of Four Gods, a Divine-category art that summons the spirits of the four constellations. The elders are shocked: the art sat in the core area that not even Heavenly Transformation experts may enter, and no one has ever cultivated it. In the challenge hall Mu Chen faces its puppet guard, rated as strong as an initial-phase Heavenly Transformation expert, and even his Level 3 Grand Flame Demon Formation does nothing. On Jiuyou's hint he looks for what powers the puppet and finds a spiritual formation in its armour.

title: Top of the Divine Soul Ranking
summary: Mu Chen destroys the formation hidden in the puppet guard with Jiuyou's flames and the Great Buddha Art, and Elder Zhu Tian counts it as a pass, letting him keep the Constellation Sutra of Four Gods. Li Xuantong, who is at the Heavenly Transformation Stage, then warns Mu Chen that he is not qualified to be with Luo Li and gives him two months before they fight; Luo Li tells Li Xuantong to stay out of her choices. To get stronger quickly, Jiuyou offers to merge her Jiuyou Flames into his spiritual power, and he needs spirit value to buy the essence and blood of the Dragon Fish of Beiming. Mu Chen climbs the Divine Soul Ranking in one run, taking third from Mo Lun and then first from Su Ling'er. Su Ling'er complains to her sister Su Xuan, third on the Heavenly Ranking, and vows to teach him a lesson.

title: Heavenly Fusion
summary: Mu Chen pays 4,000 spirit value a day to cultivate in the Level 6 Spirit Collecting Formation and dives to the bottom of its lake, where Jiuyou helps him merge the Jiuyou Flames into his spiritual power through their bloodline and compress them into a spark. Su Ling'er tracks him down; he first concedes, then fights her whip to a standstill that ends with the two of them tied together, and she leaves humiliated. On Jiuyou's advice he stops forcing his divine soul and breaks through to the Heavenly Fusion Stage. A spiritual tide is coming that will fruit the Heavenly Spiritual Lotus, whose seeds stabilise new power, so he joins the hunt. There he runs into Su Ling'er again, her rival Xu Qingqing, and Huo Feng, boss of the Qinghong Club, who demands that Mu Chen return Mo Lun's spirit value; Mu Chen refuses.

title: The Heavenly Spiritual Lotus
summary: Huo Feng, at the late phase of Heavenly Fusion, attacks Mu Chen for refusing him and is startled that a newly promoted freshman can trade blows, but breaks off when the spiritual tide starts so he can save his strength for the lotus. Mu Chen and Su Ling'er, still bickering, find the Heavenly Spiritual Lotus first, and Xu Qingqing arrives to claim it. Mu Chen holds off Xu Qingqing, who is also late-phase Heavenly Fusion and uses her Nine Heavens Spiritual Sword Art to try to cripple him, while Su Ling'er goes for the lotus. Mu Chen activates the first level of the Great Buddha Art's nine-level pagoda and smashes her Silver Dragon Sword. When the lotus fruits, he works out how to catch the living lotus seeds; Xu Qingqing threatens him with her brother Xu Huang, fifth on the Heavenly Ranking, and Su Ling'er stands with Mu Chen. They split the seeds, and Xu Qingqing runs to Xu Huang, who vows revenge.

title: Li Xuantong's challenge
summary: Back at the Luo Club, Su Ling'er turns up looking for Mu Chen, fights Luo Li instead, and the two become friends; Luo Li has also taken 83rd on the Heavenly Ranking, which people read as late-phase Heavenly Fusion. Mu Chen gives Luo Li a spiritual lotus seed, stabilises his new realm, and forms the White Tiger Divine Seal of the Constellation Sutra of Four Gods with the black paper's help. Xu Qingqing storms the club, slaps Sun'er and injures Mo Ling; Mu Chen slaps her back, and her brother Xu Huang, clearly at Heavenly Transformation, arrives to avenge her. Li Xuantong steps in and Xu Huang backs off, but Li Xuantong's deadline is up: Mu Chen refuses to leave Luo Li and accepts a duel in three days, then confesses to Luo Li. On the day, Su Xuan and He Yao, fourth on the Heavenly Ranking, are among the crowd, and Li Xuantong offers to count it a win if Mu Chen blocks three moves.

title: Three moves
summary: Li Xuantong opens with the Lingxuan Jade Palm, the move that made him famous, and Mu Chen blocks it with the Senluo Death Mark and the pagoda. Li Xuantong's second move is the Yixuan Finger of his Divine-category Tianxuan Divine Art, which Mu Chen meets with the White Tiger Divine Seal of the Constellation Sutra of Four Gods. For the third move Mu Chen asks to attack, builds the Level 4 Demon Lotus Spirit-Slaying Formation from spiritual seals, and breaks through Li Xuantong's Tianxuan Compass, so Li Xuantong concedes. Afterwards Li Xuantong tells him about Luo Li's burden: she is heir of the declining Luo race, one of the four divine races of the Western Heavenly Realm, and her dying grandfather Luo Tianshen will call her back within five years to take the inheritance and try for the Sovereign Stage. He also mentions Flame Emperor, the lower-world man whose help once saved the Luo race. Mu Chen promises Luo Li he will become as strong as Flame Emperor.

title: White Dragon City
summary: Su Xuan, third on the Heavenly Ranking, invites Mu Chen onto her team for a Heaven-level mission to explore a celestial treasure in the White Dragon Hill, worth at least 1.5 million spirit value each, with Su Ling'er, An Ran and the freshman Mu Kui. He Yao, fourth on the Heavenly Ranking, tries to buy Mu Chen's place because he knows a top master died there; Mu Chen refuses. On the road the team hears that Shen Cangsheng is hunting Mo Longzi, second on the academy's bounty list. In White Dragon City they attend the Jiuxia Chamber of Commerce auction run by Bi Sheng, where Su Ling'er outbids the young master Bai Dong, guarded by Elder Qiu, for a Spiritual Formation Ball and gives it to Mu Chen. Bai Dong then buys the White Dragon Jade Pillar, left by the White Dragon Sovereign, for ten million spirit coins. His father Bai Xuan, governor of the city, guesses Su Xuan is at middle-phase Heavenly Transformation and orders the Dragon Demon Guards to kill the team.

At night Dragon Demon Guards lure Su Xuan away and four late-phase Heavenly Fusion attackers go for the others; Mu Chen hides the injured Su Ling'er and leads the pursuers off, then turns on them with the Great Buddha Art and kills them all. The attackers carry the Dragon Demon Palace's mark, and Su Xuan explains the old war between the Dragon Demon Palace and the Northern Heaven Spiritual Academy, and why Shen Cangsheng hunts Mo Longzi. At the site where the White Dragon Sovereign died, his image appears in the sky as the treasure's entrance opens, and Bai Dong taunts Mu Chen. Inside, the team is scattered; Jiuyou points Mu Chen to Flame Spiritual Lotuses and the hope of a Flame Immortal Lotus, guarded by Flame-Devouring Pythons, and Bai Dong's party finds him.

title: The Flame Immortal Lotus
summary: Bai Dong springs his ambush and admits White Dragon City belongs to the Dragon Demon Palace; Mu Chen, facing Elder Qiu at initial-phase Heavenly Transformation, escapes by leaping into the magma pool, protected by the Jiuyou Flames. Two hundred metres down he finds a Flame Immortal Lotus guarded by the Flame-Devouring Python King, as strong as a middle-phase Heavenly Transformation expert. Jiuyou comes out in her original form, scares it off and takes a White Dragon Token from it for him, and he refines the lotus seed, which burns out the fire poison and lifts him to middle-phase Heavenly Fusion. He kills the two guards Bai Dong left behind. Elsewhere An Ran finds the Dragon and Serpent Spiritual Rings in a stone hall and is attacked by two brothers of the Lion and Tiger Gang, both near Heavenly Transformation, who take the Serpent ring; Mu Chen arrives to help her.

He beats their vice-captain with the pagoda, holds him hostage and trades him for the Serpent Spiritual Ring. Mu Chen lures the statue away alone and, on a gamble, pours spiritual power into the token, which absorbs the statue and puts it under his control. They conclude the token belonged to the White Dragon Sovereign. Feeling the pressure of a Sovereign in the depths, Mu Chen swears he will reach that level one day.

title: Mo Longzi
summary: Mu Chen takes the Great Meru Demonic Pillar's evil aura into himself and fights Bai Xuan, keeping his mind with Jiuyou guarding his divine soul while Bai Xuan uses the Blood Beast and Blood Sea Smelting. He kills Bai Xuan, then collapses with the aura eating into his meridians. At the academy, the elders learn Mo Longzi, second on the bounty list, has shown up at the White Dragon Hill and send a rescue team, and Shen Cangsheng, first on the Heavenly Ranking, sets out. Mo Longzi turns out to be Bai Xuan's backup and finds the injured team. Su Xuan and An Ran try to hold him while the others run, and Mu Chen, now spent and using only the power of his blood bond with Jiuyou, faces him. Mo Longzi, impressed that a Heavenly Fusion student killed a Heavenly Transformation expert, draws his Dragon Scale Sword.

title: He Yao's Betrayal
summary: In the Infinite Flame Realm the Flame Emperor Xiao Yan asks his mentor Yao Chen how to help the struggling Luo race, which has fought the Blood race for thousands of years; he already has someone in mind who is close to Luo Tianshen's granddaughter. At the Northern Heaven Spiritual Academy, Dean Tai Cang opens the hunting battle in the Spiritual Light Realm: the three students with the most Spirit Crystals may challenge the Three Generals of the Penalty Hall, and the winners receive the Spiritual Light Infusion from the academy's guardian, Lord Dragon Fish of Beiming. He Yao and his men torture Luo Club members for Mu Chen's location and attack Ye Sun'er; Luo Li rescues her but is poisoned. He Yao reveals he has colluded with the Holy Spiritual Academy, calls North Heaven's creed a joke and says Mu Chen is his pledge of allegiance, sent with greetings from Ji Xuan. Mu Chen arrives, uses the Thunder Body, and He Yao, claiming to be half a step into Heavenly Completion, summons the Heavenly Demon Crane.

title: The Spirit King's Hoard
summary: Xiao Xiao, the Flame Emperor's daughter, emerges from seclusion in the Infinite Flame Realm; Xiao Yan gives her a 'fun mission', but Yao Chen's rule is no leaving before she reaches Sovereign, which she says she has almost reached. At the academy the elders learn He Yao is dead, and Su Xuan and Xu Huang were injured challenging the Spirit King, leaving Mu Chen, still last in the Spirit Crystal rankings, as North Heaven's hope. Mu Chen treats Luo Li's poison and learns Ji Xuan was behind He Yao. He and Luo Li come to the aid of Zhao Qingshan's group against the Spirit King, a Heavenly Completion beast; Mu Chen reveals the Thunder Realm raised him to Heavenly Transformation. They find the Spirit King's hoard of Spirit Crystals under its cave, and Mu Chen instantly forms the Level 5 Demon Lotus Spirit-Slaying Formation while Luo Li uses the Luo Sword Art to bring it down.

title: The Three Generals of the Penalty Hall
summary: Mu Chen secures the third and final spot to challenge the Three Generals of the Penalty Hall after killing the Spirit King. Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong brief him on Gu Tianyan (Heavenly Flame Divine Art), Zhou Qingshan (Invincible Divine Art, never beaten at the same level) and Lin Zheng, a former first on the Heavenly Ranking. At the camp market Mu Chen buys Luo Li a stone for 200,000; it is a Divine Forging Stone, and she uses it to break the first of three seals Luo Tianshen placed on the Luo Divine Sword. In the first round Li Xuantong accepts Zhou Qingshan's ten-move rule, loses his senses to an illusion, and breaks it with a five-tone, five-element sword; Zhou concedes. Shen Cangsheng then beats Lin Zheng with a feint that costs him a light arm injury and is hailed as the true No. 1 of North Heaven. Mu Chen steps up against Gu Tianyan: Heavenly Flame Dragon Halberd against the Black Tortoise Divine Seal.

title: Mu Chen vs Gu Tianyan
summary: Following Shen Cangsheng's advice, Mu Chen dodges Gu Tianyan to wear down his temper, then switches to a head-on fight, saying there are people he must protect. Gu Tianyan agrees to settle it in one move; with the Thunder Body and the Black Tortoise Divine Seal Mu Chen withstands the Heavenly Flame Dragon Halberd, and Gu Tianyan admits defeat. Dean Tai Cang declares the hunting battle won, with Mu Chen, Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong as North Heaven's representatives, and sets the Spiritual Light Infusion for three days later. Shen Cangsheng tells Li Xuantong he has no chance with Luo Li, and they agree to hunt down Mo Longzi after the infusion. Luo Li scolds Mu Chen for fighting so desperately and stays with him through the night. Jiu You wakes Mu Chen: she will attempt the Thunder Tribulation again.

title: Jiu You's Thunder Tribulation
summary: Jiu You undergoes the Dark God Thunder Tribulation using the Feather given by the bald old master; a tempting voice tells her the blood bond with Mu Chen is what makes her fail and urges her to cut it. Mu Chen breaks into the tribulation to stand with her, and she passes, then falls into slumber to refine her body into the Jiuyou Nether Bird, a true divine beast, leaving him the Immortal Fire. The old master is revealed as Lord Dragon Fish of Beiming, creator of the Thunder Realm, who wants the Thunder God Pill at the heart of the Thunder Sea so he can break through to Earth Sovereign. Mu Chen agrees in return for Beiming conducting his infusion, while Mo You personally conducts Luo Li's after seeing the Luo Divine Sword. Beiming purges the Dark God Thunder poison, notices the pagoda in Mu Chen's body (Ancient Pagoda Clan), and seals the thunder in his finger as the Dark God Thunder Poison Finger. News comes that the Supreme Cauldron Spiritual Academy is about to arrive.

title: Challenge from the Supreme Cauldron Academy
summary: Lord Dragon Fish of Beiming holds off the Thunder Spirit while Mu Chen searches the Thunder Sea for the Thunder God Pill with the Thunder Body, which lasts only an hour. Dean Fei Qingsong arrives with the Supreme Cauldron Spiritual Academy while Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong are away hunting Mo Longzi, and calls for 'friendly' matches. Liu Zheng, once expelled from North Heaven for killing fellow students over tokens, crushes Xu Huang (7th on the Heavenly Ranking) and Su Xuan (4th). Mu Chen draws the lightning into his body to find the pill and nearly dies; Beiming saves him, gets the Thunder God Pill, and uses the Thunder God Lotus they also found to start Mu Chen's infusion. Luo Li, 10th on the Heavenly Ranking, defeats Liu Zheng with the Luo River sword. Fei Qingsong then fields Xue Shi, a middle-phase Heavenly Completion student.

title: Three Flowers and the White Dragon Sovereign
summary: Beiming conducts Mu Chen's infusion with his own method, Three Flowers Gather at the Crown, expecting him to bloom one flower at most. Xue Shi introduces himself as a royal of the Blood race, taunts Luo Li that Luo Tianshen has only two or three years left and that the Blood race will slaughter the Luo race once no Earth Sovereign remains, and accuses her of running from her duty. Inside Mu Chen, the White Dragon Spiritual Pearl opens, and the White Dragon Sovereign's remnant will shows his homeland devoured by an evil race from beyond the realm. Mu Chen declines to drain the pearl's power, so the Sovereign grants him a technique and tells him of the Martial Ancestor Lin Dong; Mu Chen promises one day to drive the evil race from the Sovereign's plane. Xue Shi traps Luo Li in an illusion of her dying clansmen and beats her, then mocks North Heaven. Mu Chen blooms a second and then a third flower.

title: Mu Chen vs Xue Shi
summary: Mu Chen, fresh from the infusion, returns to the arena, sees Luo Li hurt, and challenges Xue Shi, whom he recognises as middle-phase Heavenly Completion. Xue Shi uses Blood Shadow Killing Formation, Blood River to Heaven and the Blood Divine Armor, and his blood qi drains his opponent's spiritual power; the Supreme Cauldron side cannot believe Mu Chen is only at late Heavenly Transformation. Mu Chen breaks the armor from inside and out with the new Constellation Sutra of Four Gods and the Lightning Fist, knocking Xue Shi out of bounds. When Xue Shi attacks his back, Mu Chen hits him with Dark God Thunder poison; Fei Qingsong steps in, Tai Cang faces him down, and Supreme Cauldron leaves vowing revenge at the Spiritual Academy Competition. Mu Chen is hailed as third on the Heavenly Ranking. Tai Cang warns of stronger rivals such as Ji Xuan, who appears briefly, while Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong keep chasing Mo Longzi.

title: Ling Xi's Spiritual Formations
summary: Luo Li tells Mu Chen that once Xue Shi's news spreads, her grandfather will call her home, and she will push on to Sovereign to protect her people; Mu Chen vows to carry the burden with her. Dean Tai Cang says he must improve his talent, not rush his spiritual power, and sends him with a jade token to Elder Ling Xi, the academy's best spiritual formation master, to master the Spiritual Eye. Ling Xi refuses to teach men until Ye Sun'er, her student, threatens to stop working for her. Mu Chen finds the single real core among three Level 4 formations in exactly three moves, and over thirteen days goes from six to thirty formations. Elsewhere, unseen schemers set a game against North Heaven's future, with Mo Longzi as a volunteer and the owner of the Great Meru Demonic Pillar as the hoped-for prey. Ling Xi says the Spiritual Eye opens only at the brink of death and takes Mu Chen to the Spiritual Formation House.

title: The Spiritual Eye and the Black Tower
summary: In the Spiritual Formation House Mu Chen faces a formation that strikes back harder the more it is attacked, and risks death to open the Spiritual Eye as Ling Xi said; when the Black Tower (Great Buddha Art) appears in him, Ling Xi reacts, and he finds the one path to survive. Ling Xi takes the drained Mu Chen away and asks about the Black Tower, then shows him a painting he recognises as his mother. She remembers only the last five years, felt she once cultivated the Great Buddha Art, fuses spiritual power with him, warns him to keep the tower hidden, and tells him to call her Ling Xi. Luo Li contacts her friend Xiao Xiao, who has reached Sovereign and is visiting Luo Tianshen with her younger brother. In the Fog Valley, Mo Longzi with bounty-list fighters Teng Long and Chi Yu wears down Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong and poisons them with Gu poison, keeping them alive as bait. The Blood Cry Bell rings at the academy.

title: The Rescue Team Sets Out
summary: The Blood Cry Bell, carried only by the Heavenly Ranking's top ten, reports that Mo Longzi and top bounty-list names have trapped Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong in the Fog Valley. Because of a pact with the Dragon Demon Palace that elders will not interfere in the younger generation's fights, Tai Cang sends Mo You with the Penalty Hall and assigns Mu Chen, Luo Li and Su Xuan to Lin Zheng's rescue team. Mu Chen explains to Luo Li that Ling Xi's interest is the pagoda inside him, linked to her lost memories and his mother. Ling Xi leaves her bamboo grove to give him a Level 5 spiritual formation she drew for a life-or-death moment. The briefing profiles Chi Yu (7th), Mao Jiang (8th), Teng Long (6th), Gui Xiong (4th), Mu Gu (3rd), Wu Jia (5th, a formation master) and Mo Longzi, while the Dragon Demon Palace plots to reclaim the Great Meru Demonic Pillar from Mu Chen. In the Fog Valley a Void Formation Arts array scatters the team.

title: Chi Yu and Mao Jiang
summary: Scattered by Wu Jia's formations, which drain the Penalty Hall students to feed themselves, Mu Chen and Luo Li suspect they, not Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong, are the real targets. Chi Yu and Mao Jiang find them; Mao Jiang recognises Mu Chen as a Heavenly Transformation cultivator, and he beats her with the Constellation Sutra of Four Gods while Luo Li wrecks Chi Yu. Mu Gu attacks from ambush and flees. They reach Zhou Qingshan, who has been worn down, and Wu Jia turns up and consumes the Heavenly Completion Mao Jiang to feed his formation. Luo Li holds Wu Jia off while Mu Chen finds Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong, who are too poisoned to cure themselves. After the Jiuyou Flames prove too slow, Mu Chen uses the Immortal Fire and recognises the poison as Ji Xuan's. Luo Li tells Wu Jia she will break his formation in three breaths.

title: The Three Generals Captured
summary: Tian Sheng, dean of the Holy Spiritual Academy and a peak 5th-grade Sovereign, checks with Ji Xuan that the Fog Valley trap is ready; Ji Xuan says he will only watch as a student. Mu Chen purges the poison from Shen Cangsheng and then Li Xuantong with the Immortal Fire and his evolved Dark God Thunder Poison Finger, notes the poison is tied to the Holy Spiritual Academy, and suspects the Dragon Demon Palace wants the Great Meru Demonic Pillar inside him. The two seniors say the purge has even pushed them further. The Three Generals of the Penalty Hall force Teng Long and a comrade to give in, but Mo Longzi, Wu Jia and the others ambush them and take them prisoner as bargaining chips. Luo Li breaks Wu Jia's formation in three breaths, though the drained students have fainted, and Wu Jia admits the Supreme Cauldron Academy is colluding with the Dragon Demon Palace. Shen Cangsheng arrives to settle the score with Mo Longzi.

title: Four One-on-One Duels
summary: Mo Longzi dismisses Mu Chen as merely Heavenly Transformation, sparing him only because the Dragon Demon Palace needs the Great Meru Demonic Pillar, and boasts he will prove the palace has more than Mo Xingtian. The two sides agree to four duels to the death: Luo Li takes Mu Gu, Mu Chen takes Wu Jia, Shen Cangsheng faces Mo Longzi, and Li Xuantong takes Gui Xiong. Mu Gu flees to buy time and Luo Li chases him. Mu Chen easily breaks Wu Jia's formations, having trained against Ling Xi's, and matches him in close combat, then sees through the Nine Mountains and Rivers Formation, which Wu Jia says has killed 13 Heavenly Completion experts. Mo Longzi mocks Shen Cangsheng as the first on the Heavenly Ranking, and Shen answers with the Judgment Divine Art and the Spear of Judgment.

title: Mo Longzi's Dragon-transforming Blood Art
summary: The four duels to the death between North Heaven's students and Mo Longzi's bounty-list fighters continue in the Fog Valley. Mu Chen forces his Spiritual Eye open in the middle of the fighting, though it takes time to work. As the fights turn against North Heaven, the students risk everything to come to one another's aid. Mo Longzi unleashes the Dragon Demon Palace's secret technique, the Dragon-transforming Blood Art, and vows to send them all to hell together. By the end Shen Cangsheng, Li Xuantong and Luo Li are all wounded, and Mu Chen wonders whether he has any choice left but to use his hidden trump card.

title: Mo Longzi falls
summary: With Shen Cangsheng, Li Xuantong and Luo Li wounded, Mu Chen lets the Great Meru Demonic Pillar's power take him over again, the same demonic look he had on the White Dragon mission, while the others buy him time. He brushes off the Three Generals and Mo Longzi's Dragon-transforming Blood Art and beats Mo Longzi, who uses the Dragon Demon Divine Art and still loses, as payback for hurting Luo Li. When Mu Chen moves to finish him, the Black Dragon Sovereign strikes to take back the Pillar, and Dean Tai Cang steps in to protect the students, calling it a fight of the younger generation. The Black Dragon Sovereign warns that the Dragon Demon Palace will take Mu Chen's life and North Heaven will be destroyed. At the Holy Spiritual Academy, Ji Xuan's elder teaches him that the strong must be cold-blooded, and Ji Xuan takes charge of the collaboration between Master Wuliang and the Dragon Demon Palace.

title: The Dragon Demon Brand and Mu Chen's bet
summary: The dean and the three Elders of the Celestial Seat praise Mu Chen, then set up a formation to erase the Dragon Demon Brand the Black Dragon Sovereign planted on the Great Meru Demonic Pillar. The brand lets the Dragon Demon Palace descend; the Black Dragon Sovereign tries to blow up the formation and free the Pillar until Lord Beiming, the Northern Sea Dragon, freezes him and drives him off. The retreating Palace learns that Beiming is a ninth-grade Sovereign close to Earth Sovereign, and that Master Wuliang has agreed to work with them through the Holy Spiritual Academy, aiming at the Holy Spirit Mountain Trial in a month. Tai Cang explains that the trial's Holy Spirit Baptism helps geniuses survive the Three Sovereign Disasters, but refuses to send Mu Chen, who is only at the late phase of Heavenly Transformation. Mu Chen bets the dean and elders that he can reach Heavenly Completion within a month. Ling Xi finds their spiritual power resonates, begins pouring hers into him in her courtyard pool, and recovers a memory of being taken in as a beggar child by 'Aunt Jing', who gave her the Yin volume of the art and saved the Yang volume for her son.

title: Heavenly Completion in a month
summary: Mu Chen turns down Ling Xi's transfer of power, not wanting to use others as stepping stones, and a vision of his mother Qing Yanjing appears to him. Elsewhere Xiao Xiao reads Luo Li's letter about the cold young elder who favours Mu Chen and even gave him a Level 5 Spiritual Formation, then uncovers Blood race spies inside the Luo race and sets off to check on Luo Li. Ling Xi offers a harsher way: pry open a corner of the academy's Level 8 Spirit Collecting Formation, built by Lord Beiming, for a spiritual energy cleansing that only his Thunder Body could survive. The dean and elders let it run while the students, and a Heavenly Ranking pair who have been shaken since the Penalty Hall rescue, watch. Ling Xi tells Luo Li she was raised by Aunt Jing and is like a sister to Mu Chen. title: Holy Spiritual City
summary: Tai Cang and the elders lead Mu Chen to Holy Spirit Mountain, with Ling Xi and Luo Li along; Shen Cangsheng promises him a match for the top of the Heavenly Ranking when he returns, and the trial will be broadcast back to the academy. At the Holy Spiritual Pavilion in wind-powered Holy Spiritual City, Xia Youran of the Jiuxia Chamber of Commerce greets Mu Chen, who reached Heavenly Completion within a month, and warns him how hard the Three Tribulations are. Liu Ying of the Anying Chamber, who claims to be her fiance, and his friend Zhou Xuan of Mount Xuanyin Sect pick a fight; Dong Yuan of the Tianyuan Chamber watches. Mo Xingtian of the Dragon Demon Palace arrives to kill Mu Chen, and Ling Xi reveals herself as a Sovereign, sending him flying until the Black Dragon Sovereign steps in and the two sides back off before the baptism. That night Luo Li warns Mu Chen that Mo Xingtian has already passed the Human Body Disaster and that Liu Ying and Zhou Xuan are close to it.

title: The Heavenly Sovereign's remains
summary: The black paper seals the fragment of the ancient Heavenly Sovereign's remains that was driving the Tornado, and as it fades Liu Ying, Zhou Xuan and Dong Yuan close in on Mu Chen while Xia Youran tries to hold them. Wen Busheng steps in to help, and Mu Chen escapes with a fast movement technique. The fragment opens the Heavenly Sovereign's Remains Realm, where its essence blood nearly bursts Mu Chen's body before flowing into the black paper; his Thunder Body advances to its second pattern, and he learns the black paper is the sealing page of the Immortal Scroll, which shows him a fragment of the Indestructible Solar Body and promises the Primordial Immortal Body, fourth of the 99 Supreme Dharma Bodies, if he finds all four pages. Meanwhile Ji Xuan trades barbs with Luo Li about friendship and power, and his grandfather tells the Holy Son to keep his mind on the plan. On the Nine Heavens Stairway, Mo Xingtian holds the top while Tai Cang and Ling Xi wait; Mu Chen arrives with the Dragon Soaring stage of the Dragon Soaring Art, climbs past everyone who tries to stop him, joins Wen Busheng, and faces Liu Ying's challenge before Mo Xingtian calls his allies to the summit.

title: Mu Chen kills Mo Xingtian

Mo Xingtian boasts about crushing the divine soul of a North Heaven senior, and Mu Chen, fuelled by the academy's years of anger, burns Immortal Fire with his other flames as the watching students cheer him on. Ji Xuan's grandfather sums up Mu Chen as ruthless, sharp and formidable but says he has no idea what waits outside the mountain. At the academy the warding formation is broken, Mo You and Zhu Tian are pinned at the Holy Spiritual Pavilion, and Lord Beiming confronts Master Wuliang, mocking him over the Martial Ancestor; Wuliang asks which he can save, the academy or Tai Cang, now trapped in a Three Dragons Burning Heaven Cauldron. title: Mu Chen's mother

She dismisses the Yellow Dragon Sovereign as a mere first-grade Sovereign and, despite his pleas and the Black Dragon Sovereign rushing to help, destroys him, then vows to wipe out the Dragon Demon Palace. The Black Dragon Sovereign threatens her with Master Wuliang, a ninth-grade Sovereign, but inside her pagoda it means nothing; the Palace flees by Blood Escape and two get away, and Wuliang withdraws on realising she is a Saint-grade Heavenly Sovereign. title: The Thunder Realm and a trip home
summary: The academy raises memorial tablets for the fallen, including Su Ling'er, and Tai Cang laments the losses, the equal-for-all philosophy that deters geniuses, and the long-sealed North Heaven Gate; Shen Cangsheng and the students demand he open it. The top ten of the Heavenly Ranking go into the North Heaven Gate for half a year, while Lord Beiming takes Mu Chen for three months of body tempering in the Thunder Realm, telling him the North Heaven Continent may be a piece on someone's chessboard. Mu Chen comes out with the Mid-Tier Four-Striped Thunder Body and learns of the Mirror of Judgment, which created the Spiritual Land and is used at the competition's quarterfinals. title: Ninth on the leaderboard, and the Spiritual Land story

The Wood God Tablet shows this ruin was one of six halls of the Divine Wood Palace, and that each tablet leads to the main hall and treasures such as the Nine-Yang Ganoderma. That prompts Mu Chen to tell his team, and Ji Xuan to tell Cao Gang, how Mu Chen and Luo Li went from hunter and hunted to a couple on the Spiritual Land. title: Mu Fengyang holds the line
summary: While Mu Chen and Luo Li spend half a month in seclusion breaking through with the Spiritual Fruit, Mu Fengyang and Zhao Qingshan guard the cave, and the rumours keep most teams away. Wen Qingxuan and Pin'er read the ruse, and Ji Xuan pays the Alliance of Academies to kill Mu Chen for his Wood God Tablet. The Alliance sends Chen Xi with a crowd of fighters. Mu Fengyang bluffs them as a reclusive master from the Martial Realm, 'suppressing' himself to the Human Body Disaster and taking Chen Xi's punch unharmed thanks to a protective treasure from Mu Chen. An Alliance leader the others call 'Second Boss' sees through it. Mu Fengyang and Zhao Qingshan fall back through Mu Chen's pre-laid formations, and Mu Fengyang, ribs broken, refuses to abandon his friends. He tells Qingshan he only needs to be able to stand in front of his teammates.

title: Mu Chen breaks through; Wen Qingxuan's alliance
summary: Mu Fengyang, bow broken and armor gone, keeps standing in front of Zhao Qingshan until Mu Chen comes out of seclusion, now past the Human Body Disaster. The Alliance attackers sneer that he has only just passed it and charge with the Heaven-Suppressing Stele, then break and run. Wen Qingxuan arrives, offers her team's whole point total to take Luo Li into Phoenix, and fights North Heaven until she hears that Mu Chen saved Tang Mei'er's team. She warns them that the Alliance of Academies, the underground point-trading ring captained in public by Mo Yu of the Ghost Spiritual Academy, has been paid by Ji Xuan to kill Mu Chen. North Heaven and Phoenix form an alliance. At the trading town, Ji Xuan rebukes Mo Yu for failing, hands over Cao Gang's Wood God Tablet, and is pointed to the Blood race's fourth prince Xue Tiandu, who has an old grudge with Luo Li.

title: The trading town
summary: On the way to the real Divine Wood Palace ruins, Wen Qingxuan says the minor divine art in a Wood God Tablet could gravely wound a first-grade Sovereign, but is hard to use. She takes North Heaven into the Relic Continent's trading town, where she makes a show of holding Mu Chen's hand, and later buys him a combat spiritual pill and the formation map of the level-5 Small Thousand Sword Spiritual Formation as an 'investment'. Mu Fengyang and Zhao Qingshan lose at a rigged Alliance gambling table run by Mr. Qin, and Mu Chen breaks its hidden spiritual formations, laid by the Alliance boss Xiao Huang, to win their way out. At the Star Hall of the Infinite Flame Realm, Xiao Xiao reports that Blood race spies have bribed Luo race elders to back a marriage between Luo Li and the Blood race. Xiao Yan and Yao Chen recall how Qing Yanjing of the Ancient Pagoda Clan refused a match with Mohe Tian and chose a man of low standing. The Alliance brothers then set off for Wood God Mountain.

title: Xue Tiandu and the Wood God Trial
summary: At the Wood God Mountain Ruins, Wen Qingxuan confronts the First Holy Son of the Holy Spiritual Academy, who betrayed her and stole Phoenix's Wood God Tablet, and who now openly courts the strongest side. Xue Tiandu, fourth prince of the Blood race, comes with the Supreme Cauldron team and asks for a marriage alliance with Luo Li, saying Luo race elders support it. Mu Chen calls him a 'Blood Toad' and says anyone who wants her has to step over him first. A third party proposes that the fifteen-level trial settle it, and Mu Chen refuses to treat Luo Li as a wager. Wu Yingying turns up again to the team's amusement before the teams offer their Wood God Tablets and are teleported in pairs. Mu Chen and Luo Li are paired, Wen Qingxuan is paired with a self-styled 'nobody', and Xue Tiandu with an Alliance member. The first levels are easy, but by the sixth the guards reach Heavenly Completion and then the peak of the Human Body Disaster. One team that tries to quit dies when the corrupted core refuses to stop the trial.

title: The black paper purifies the trial
summary: The trial's rooms keep escalating toward Spirit Disaster-level foes, and teams that choose the green orb's extra reward instead of the red orb's recovery die. Mu Chen and Luo Li break into the formation core, the Wood God Mountain Trial Core, where the remnant soul of the ancient Wood race says evil energy has corrupted the inheritance. Mu Chen uses his black paper, a sealing page, to purify it and stop Room Chen, Room Shen and Room Hai. With one stop left, he has to choose between his ally Wen Qingxuan and Wu Yingying, whose partner, the First Holy Son, is using her as a shield and betting that Mu Chen will save her. Mu Chen saves Wu Yingying, while Wen Qingxuan's partner fakes an injury and leaves her fighting alone. The remnant soul tells Mu Chen the green-orb rewards repair and upgrade a Wood God Guard. He takes that shortcut with the guard he already owns, climbs to the final level and faces a Half-step Sovereign guard.

title: The Half-step Sovereign guard and the Wood race's will
summary: At the final level Mu Chen, still only at the Human Body Disaster, faces a Wood God Guard at Half-step Sovereign and brings it down with his upgraded guard. Xue Tiandu meanwhile fights a Spirit Disaster-level guard using his partner's blood. Offered the choice to leave alone with the rewards, Mu Chen chooses to keep going so every survivor is rewarded, thinking of those who sacrificed themselves at North Heaven half a year earlier. His will to protect clears the inheritance trial. He wins the Nine-Yang Ganoderma and sees a vision of the ancient war in which the Wood race stayed to fight so four of ten races could escape. The remnant soul directs him to the Spirit Treasury and its Supreme Liquid. Wen Qingxuan leaves with the message 'Friendship over', Wu Yingying storms off, and Wang Zhong takes her under his wing. The Alliance brothers plan to use a Wood Spirit Token and a mirror map to take the Supreme Liquid.
